(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* Executes median selection, pairwise Euclidean discrepancy checking, and sensor drift     *)
(* monitoring for optical bench tri-axial accelerometers and redundant quad-cell preamps.   *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* --- 2.1 Accelerometer Axis X 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccX_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccX_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccX_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_B_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    (* All 3 channels healthy: perform robust median selection *)
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2;
    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelX_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := FALSE;
    (* Check for subtle sensor drift across channels *)
    IF ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 THEN
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0001; (* Accel X Sensor Channel Drift Warning *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0002; (* Accel X Channel C Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bAccX_B_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0004; (* Accel X Channel A Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSIF bAccX_A_OK AND bAccX_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelX_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelX_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0008; (* Accel X Channel B Failed: Degraded 1oo2 *)
ELSE
    rVotedAccelX_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0010; (* All Accel X Channels Failed *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Accelerometer Axis Y 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccY_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccY_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccY_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_B_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) THEN

    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelY_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelY_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
    IF ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 OR
       ABS(rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2 - rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2) > c_rAccelDiscrepancyTol_mps2 THEN

    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0020;
ELSIF bAccY_B_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bAccY_A_OK AND bAccY_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelY_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelY_C_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSE
    rVotedAccelY_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0020; (* All Accel Y Channels Failed *)

(* --- 2.3 Accelerometer Axis Z 2oo3 Voting --- *)
bAccZ_A_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccZ_B_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= 50.0);
bAccZ_C_OK := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 >= -50.0) AND (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 <= 50.0);

IF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_B_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN
    IF (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) OR
       (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2) THEN
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2;
    ELSIF (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) OR
          (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 >= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2 AND rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 <= rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2) THEN

    ELSE
        rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_B_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_A_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2) * 0.5;
    bAcc_Degraded_1oo2 := TRUE;
ELSIF bAccZ_B_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := (rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_B_mps2 + rBusMicroVib_AccelZ_C_mps2) * 0.5;

ELSIF bAccZ_A_OK AND bAccZ_C_OK THEN

ELSE
    rVotedAccelZ_mps2 := 0.0;
    bAcc_AllFailed_Trip := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0040; (* All Accel Z Channels Failed *)

(* --- 2.4 Quad-Cell Preamplifier Dual-Redundancy Cross-Validation --- *)
IF ABS(rQuadCell_A_mV - rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_B_mV - rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_C_mV - rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV OR
   ABS(rQuadCell_D_mV - rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV) > c_rQuadCellDiscrepancyTol_mV THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0100; (* Quad-Cell Preamplifier Redundancy Mismatch *)
    (* Select primary unless primary saturated / open *)
    IF (rQuadCell_A_mV < 0.0 OR rQuadCell_A_mV > 2500.0) THEN
        rVotedQuad_A_mV := rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_B_mV := rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_C_mV := rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV;
        rVotedQuad_D_mV := rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV;
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0200; (* Switched to Secondary Quad-Cell *)
    ELSE
        rVotedQuad_A_mV := rQuadCell_A_mV;
        rVotedQuad_B_mV := rQuadCell_B_mV;
        rVotedQuad_C_mV := rQuadCell_C_mV;
        rVotedQuad_D_mV := rQuadCell_D_mV;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rVotedQuad_A_mV := (rQuadCell_A_mV + rQuadCell_A_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_B_mV := (rQuadCell_B_mV + rQuadCell_B_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_C_mV := (rQuadCell_C_mV + rQuadCell_C_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
    rVotedQuad_D_mV := (rQuadCell_D_mV + rQuadCell_D_Redundant_mV) * 0.5;
END_IF;

(* Thermal Stability Window Checks *)
IF ABS(rOpticsBenchTemp_degC - 20.0) > 3.0 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0400; (* Optical Bench Temperature Deviation *)
END_IF;
IF ABS(rLaserSeedTemp_degC - c_rLaserSeedNominalTemp_degC) > 1.5 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_0800; (* Laser LO Seed Temperature Thermal Drift *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 3.0 QUAD-CELL PHOTODIODE NUTATION DEMODULATION & BEAM CENTROID DECOUPLING                 *)
(* Computes sum and difference ratios, evaluates 5th-order polynomial distortion              *)
(* linearization, executes synchronous lock-in mixing for conical scan nutation, and decouples*)
(* spacecraft rigid-body angular rate disturbances from optical line-of-sight pointing.      *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rQuadSum_mV := rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_B_mV + rVotedQuad_C_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV;

IF rQuadSum_mV > 20.0 THEN
    (* Differential quadrant coordinates *)
    rQuadDiffX_mV := (rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV) - (rVotedQuad_B_mV + rVotedQuad_C_mV);
    rQuadDiffY_mV := (rVotedQuad_A_mV + rVotedQuad_B_mV) - (rVotedQuad_C_mV + rVotedQuad_D_mV);
    
    (* Normalized quadrant ratios *)
    rRawCentroid_X := rQuadDiffX_mV / rQuadSum_mV;
    rRawCentroid_Y := rQuadDiffY_mV / rQuadSum_mV;
    
    (* Saturation limiter on normalized quadrant ratio *)
    IF rRawCentroid_X > 0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_X := 0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_X < -0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_X := -0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_Y > 0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_Y := 0.95; END_IF;
    IF rRawCentroid_Y < -0.95 THEN rRawCentroid_Y := -0.95; END_IF;
    
    (* 5th-Order Polynomial Distortion Linearization for Gaussian Spot on Crosshair Gap *)
    (* Theta = K_lin * Ratio * (1 + K_cub * Ratio^2 + K_quin * Ratio^4) *)
    rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := c_rQuadCell_K_lin * rRawCentroid_X * (1.0 + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_cub * (rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X) + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_quin * (rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X * rRawCentroid_X));
                              
    rLinearizedPos_El_urad := c_rQuadCell_K_lin * rRawCentroid_Y * (1.0 + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_cub * (rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y) + 
                              c_rQuadCell_K_quin * (rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y * rRawCentroid_Y));
ELSE
    rRawCentroid_X         := 0.0;
    rRawCentroid_Y         := 0.0;
    rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := 0.0;
    rLinearizedPos_El_urad := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Conical Scan Nutation Phase Accumulation & Demodulation *)
rNutationPhase := rNutationPhase + (2.0 * c_rPi * c_rNutationFreq_Hz * c_rTs);
IF rNutationPhase >= (2.0 * c_rPi) THEN
    rNutationPhase := rNutationPhase - (2.0 * c_rPi);
END_IF;

(* Synchronous mixing products with in-phase (cos) and quadrature (sin) carriers *)
rDemod_I_Az := (rQuadSum_mV * COS(rNutationPhase)) * 0.002;
rDemod_Q_El := (rQuadSum_mV * SIN(rNutationPhase)) * 0.002;

(* 4th-Order Direct-Form-II Transposed IIR Low-Pass Filter Cascade (f_cutoff = 40 Hz) *)
(* Filters demodulated nutation envelope to isolate steady-state pointing vector *)
rLPF_X_w[0] := rDemod_I_Az - (-1.6475 * rLPF_X_w[1] + 1.1098 * rLPF_X_w[2] - 0.2842 * rLPF_X_w[3]);
rDemod_I_Az := 0.0018 * (rLPF_X_w[0] + 3.0 * rLPF_X_w[1] + 3.0 * rLPF_X_w[2] + rLPF_X_w[3]);
rLPF_X_w[3] := rLPF_X_w[2];
rLPF_X_w[2] := rLPF_X_w[1];
rLPF_X_w[1] := rLPF_X_w[0];

rLPF_Y_w[0] := rDemod_Q_El - (-1.6475 * rLPF_Y_w[1] + 1.1098 * rLPF_Y_w[2] - 0.2842 * rLPF_Y_w[3]);
rDemod_Q_El := 0.0018 * (rLPF_Y_w[0] + 3.0 * rLPF_Y_w[1] + 3.0 * rLPF_Y_w[2] + rLPF_Y_w[3]);
rLPF_Y_w[3] := rLPF_Y_w[2];
rLPF_Y_w[2] := rLPF_Y_w[1];
rLPF_Y_w[1] := rLPF_Y_w[0];

(* Spacecraft Bus Rigid-Body Angular Rate Decoupling Feedforward *)
(* Converts body gyro rates [mrad/s] to Line-of-Sight error compensation [urad] *)
rLinearizedPos_Az_urad := rLinearizedPos_Az_urad - (rSpacecraftBodyRate_Yaw_mrads * 1000.0 * c_rTs);
rLinearizedPos_El_urad := rLinearizedPos_El_urad - (rSpacecraftBodyRate_Pitch_mrads * 1000.0 * c_rTs);

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 4.0 SPACECRAFT STRUCTURAL MICRO-VIBRATION FEEDFORWARD NULLING (FxLMS)                     *)
(* Adaptive Filtered-X Least Mean Squares FIR Filter nulling Reaction Wheel Assembly (RWA)  *)
(* dynamic unbalance harmonics and cryocooler structural tones measured by 2oo3 accelerometers*)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Update input delay lines with newest voted accelerations *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
    x_delay_X[iLoopCounter] := x_delay_X[iLoopCounter - 1];
    x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter] := x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter - 1];
END_FOR;
x_delay_X[0] := rVotedAccelX_mps2;
x_delay_Y[0] := rVotedAccelY_mps2;

(* Convolve reference through 8-tap secondary path filter model S_hat(z) *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 15 TO 1 BY -1 DO
    x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] := x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter - 1];
    x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] := x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter - 1];
END_FOR;

x_filtered_X[0] := 0.0;
x_filtered_Y[0] := 0.0;
FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 7 DO
    IF jLoopCounter <= 15 THEN
        x_filtered_X[0] := x_filtered_X[0] + S_secondary_path[jLoopCounter] * x_delay_X[jLoopCounter];
        x_filtered_Y[0] := x_filtered_Y[0] + S_secondary_path[jLoopCounter] * x_delay_Y[jLoopCounter];
    END_IF;
END_FOR;

(* Calculate Feedforward Cancellation Control Signal: u_ff = W^T * x *)
rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := 0.0;
rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := 0.0;
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 15 DO
    rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V + W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] * x_delay_X[iLoopCounter];
    rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := rFeedforwardCmd_El_V + W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] * x_delay_Y[iLoopCounter];
END_FOR;

(* Normalized LMS Weight Adaptation with Leakage Factor:                                     *)
(* W[k+1] = (1 - leakage) * W[k] + (mu / (||x_filt||^2 + eps)) * error * x_filt[k]            *)
IF (iState = 70 OR iState = 80 OR iState = 90) THEN
    FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 15 DO
        W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] := (1.0 - c_rFxLMS_Leakage) * W_feedforward_Az[iLoopCounter] +
            (c_rFxLMS_Mu / (x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] * x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter] + c_rFxLMS_Eps)) *
            rTrackingError_Az_urad * x_filtered_X[iLoopCounter];
            
        W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] := (1.0 - c_rFxLMS_Leakage) * W_feedforward_El[iLoopCounter] +
            (c_rFxLMS_Mu / (x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] * x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter] + c_rFxLMS_Eps)) *
            rTrackingError_El_urad * x_filtered_Y[iLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
END_IF;

(* Clamp feedforward voltage output to prevent actuator preemption *)
IF rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V > 25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V < -25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V := -25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_El_V > 25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := 25.0; END_IF;
IF rFeedforwardCmd_El_V < -25.0 THEN rFeedforwardCmd_El_V := -25.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 5.0 ORBITAL DOPPLER FREQUENCY SYNCHRONIZATION & HETERODYNE LO LOCK                        *)
(* Dual-loop optical frequency tracking: Coarse submount thermal loop (-12.5 GHz/deg C)     *)
(* cascaded with fast direct DFB laser cavity injection current tuning (+/- 2.5 GHz).       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Measure beat note error relative to coherent 80 MHz intermediate frequency target *)
rMeasuredBeatFreq_MHz       := rHeterodyneIF_BeatFreq_MHz;
rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz := rMeasuredBeatFreq_MHz - c_rIntermediateFreqTarget_MHz;

(* Ephemeris line-of-sight Doppler feedforward calculation *)
(* Required submount temperature offset: Delta_T = Delta_f_Doppler / Tuning_Sensitivity *)
rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC := c_rLaserSeedNominalTemp_degC + 
                                  (rEstimatedDopplerShift_GHz / c_rLaserThermalTuning_GHz_degC);

(* Slow Thermal Loop PI Integral Regulator with Anti-Windup *)
rDopplerThermalIntegral := rDopplerThermalIntegral + (0.012 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz * 0.001 * c_rTs);
IF rDopplerThermalIntegral > 35.0 THEN rDopplerThermalIntegral := 35.0; END_IF;
IF rDopplerThermalIntegral < 15.0 THEN rDopplerThermalIntegral := 15.0; END_IF;
rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC := rLaserLO_TECTemp_Setpoint_degC + (rDopplerThermalIntegral - 25.0);

(* Fast Injection Current Loop (Bandwidth > 100 kHz): Lead-Lag Filter + PI Controller *)
(* Lead-Lag compensator transfer function: H(s) = (s + 20000) / (s + 120000) *)
rLeadLagState_1 := 0.8825 * rLeadLagState_1 + 0.1175 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz;
rDopplerCurrentIntegral := rDopplerCurrentIntegral + (1.85 * rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz * c_rTs);
IF rDopplerCurrentIntegral > 4.5 THEN rDopplerCurrentIntegral := 4.5; END_IF;
IF rDopplerCurrentIntegral < -4.5 THEN rDopplerCurrentIntegral := -4.5; END_IF;

rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := (0.045 * rLeadLagState_1) + rDopplerCurrentIntegral +
                             (rEstimatedDopplerRate_MHzs / (c_rLaserCurrentTuning_GHz_mA * 1000.0) * 0.1);

(* Direct current limits: +/- 5.0 mA *)
IF rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA > 5.0 THEN rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := 5.0; END_IF;
IF rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA < -5.0 THEN rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA := -5.0; END_IF;

(* Coherent Heterodyne Lock Detector *)
IF ABS(rFreqDiscriminatorError_MHz) <= 2.5 AND (rRxOpticalPower_dBm >= c_rRxPowerLock_dBm) THEN
    bDopplerPhaseLocked := TRUE;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Doppler Carrier Frequency Locked *)
ELSE
    bDopplerPhaseLocked := FALSE;
    dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord AND NOT 16#0000_0008;
    IF (iState = 80) THEN
        iCycleSlipCounter := iCycleSlipCounter + 1;
        dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_1000; (* Doppler Frequency Cycle Slip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.0 6TH-ORDER STATE-SPACE MODEL & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZATION              *)
(* Real-time receding horizon state prediction, innovation correction, unrolled quadratic   *)
(* cost gradient descent, and Bouc-Wen inverse piezoelectric hysteresis compensation.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 6.1 State-Space Observer: Prior State Propagation x_pred = A * x_est + B * u_prev *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
    x_pred[iLoopCounter] := 0.0;
    FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
        x_pred[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + A_mat[iLoopCounter, jLoopCounter] * x_est[jLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
    x_pred[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + 
                            B_mat[iLoopCounter, 0] * (u_mpc_accum_Az - 65.0) + 
                            B_mat[iLoopCounter, 1] * (u_mpc_accum_El - 65.0);
END_FOR;

(* Observer Output Prediction: y_est = C * x_pred *)
y_est[0] := C_mat[0, 0] * x_pred[0];
y_est[1] := C_mat[1, 2] * x_pred[2];

(* Compute Measurement Innovation Vector: y_innov = y_meas - y_est *)
y_innov[0] := rLinearizedPos_Az_urad - y_est[0];
y_innov[1] := rLinearizedPos_El_urad - y_est[1];

(* State Correction: x_est = x_pred + L * y_innov *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 5 DO
    x_est[iLoopCounter] := x_pred[iLoopCounter] + 
                           L_gain[iLoopCounter, 0] * y_innov[0] + 
                           L_gain[iLoopCounter, 1] * y_innov[1];
END_FOR;

(* Extract Filtered Line-of-Sight Angular Tracking Errors *)
rTrackingError_Az_urad := rTargetAngle_Az_urad - x_est[0];
rTrackingError_El_urad := rTargetAngle_El_urad - x_est[2];

(* 6.2 Model Predictive Control (MPC) Receding Horizon Optimization *)
(* Formulate Gradient Vector g = H * delta_u_0 - F_error *)
g_mpc[0] := -(Q_weight_Az * rTrackingError_Az_urad * 0.00045) + (R_weight_Az * (u_mpc_accum_Az - 65.0) * 0.001);
g_mpc[1] := -(Q_weight_El * rTrackingError_El_urad * 0.00045) + (R_weight_El * (u_mpc_accum_El - 65.0) * 0.001);
g_mpc[2] := -(P_weight_Az * rTrackingError_Az_urad * 0.00025);
g_mpc[3] := -(P_weight_El * rTrackingError_El_urad * 0.00025);

(* Unrolled Quadratic Programming Step via Inverse Hessian: delta_u = -H_inv * g *)
FOR iLoopCounter := 0 TO 3 DO
    delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] := 0.0;
    FOR jLoopCounter := 0 TO 3 DO
        delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] := delta_u_mpc[iLoopCounter] - H_inv[iLoopCounter, jLoopCounter] * g_mpc[jLoopCounter];
    END_FOR;
END_FOR;

(* Slew Rate Enforcement on Control Increment (|Delta_u| <= 2.5 V/cycle) *)
IF delta_u_mpc[0] > c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[0] := c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[0] < -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[0] := -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[1] > c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[1] := c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;
IF delta_u_mpc[1] < -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V THEN delta_u_mpc[1] := -c_rMaxPiezoStep_V; END_IF;

(* Accumulate Control Input with Actuator Saturation [-20.0 V to +150.0 V] *)
IF (iState = 70 OR iState = 80 OR iState = 90) THEN
    u_mpc_accum_Az := u_mpc_accum_Az + delta_u_mpc[0];
    u_mpc_accum_El := u_mpc_accum_El + delta_u_mpc[1];
ELSE
    (* Controlled decay toward 65.0 V electrical center during non-tracking states *)
    u_mpc_accum_Az := u_mpc_accum_Az + 0.05 * (65.0 - u_mpc_accum_Az);
    u_mpc_accum_El := u_mpc_accum_El + 0.05 * (65.0 - u_mpc_accum_El);
END_IF;

IF u_mpc_accum_Az > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN u_mpc_accum_Az := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_Az < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN u_mpc_accum_Az := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_El > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN u_mpc_accum_El := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF u_mpc_accum_El < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN u_mpc_accum_El := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;

(* 6.3 Inverse Bouc-Wen Piezoelectric Hysteresis Pre-Distortion Compensation *)
(* dh/dt = alpha * du/dt - beta * |du/dt| * h * |h|^(n-1) - gamma * du/dt * |h|^n *)
rHystState_Az := rHystState_Az + (c_rBoucWen_Alpha * delta_u_mpc[0]) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Beta * ABS(delta_u_mpc[0]) * rHystState_Az) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Gamma * delta_u_mpc[0] * ABS(rHystState_Az));

rHystState_El := rHystState_El + (c_rBoucWen_Alpha * delta_u_mpc[1]) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Beta * ABS(delta_u_mpc[1]) * rHystState_El) - 
                 (c_rBoucWen_Gamma * delta_u_mpc[1] * ABS(rHystState_El));

(* Synthesize Final High-Voltage Piezo Output Commands:                                     *)
(* V_piezo = u_mpc + u_feedforward + u_pointahead - Hysteresis_Correction                    *)
rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := u_mpc_accum_Az + rFeedforwardCmd_Az_V + 
                        (rTargetPointAhead_Az_urad / c_rPiezoD33_um_V) - (0.12 * rHystState_Az);

rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := u_mpc_accum_El + rFeedforwardCmd_El_V + 
                         (rTargetPointAhead_El_urad / c_rPiezoD33_um_V) - (0.12 * rHystState_El);

(* Axial Piston Focus Voltage: Compensates optical bench bulk thermal expansion *)
rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 60.0 + (rOpticsBenchTemp_degC - 20.0) * 2.85;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V > 120.0 THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 120.0; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V < 0.0 THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Final Saturation Safeguards on Piezo Command Rails *)
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V > c_rPiezoVoltsMax THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMax; END_IF;
IF rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V < c_rPiezoVoltsMin THEN rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V := c_rPiezoVoltsMin; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 7.0 COARSE GIMBAL OFF-LOAD & DESATURATION FEEDFORWARD                                     *)
(* Low-pass filters FSM mirror deflection to offload continuous DC line-of-sight offsets     *)
(* onto the Coarse Pointing Assembly (CPA) gimbals, preserving full FSM dynamic range.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad := (0.9985 * rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad) + (0.0015 * x_est[0]);
rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad := (0.9985 * rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad) + (0.0015 * x_est[2]);

IF ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad) > c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad THEN
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := (rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad - 
        (c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad * (rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad / ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_Az_urad)))) * 
        c_rDesaturationGain;
ELSE
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad) > c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad THEN
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := (rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad - 
        (c_rDesaturationDeadband_urad * (rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad / ABS(rFSM_BiasFilter_El_urad)))) * 
        c_rDesaturationGain;
ELSE
    rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp CPA desaturation demand rates to maximum mechanical limits (+/- 15.0 mrad/s) *)
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads > 15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 15.0; END_IF;
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads < -15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := -15.0; END_IF;
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads > 15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 15.0; END_IF;
IF rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads < -15.0 THEN rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := -15.0; END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* 8.0 FINITE STATE MACHINE (13 OPERATIONAL STATES)                                          *)
(* Orchestrates optical acquisition, nutation spiral search, Doppler locking, high-rate       *)
(* coherent communication tracking, loss-of-signal relock, and safe park sequencing.        *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPreviousState), PT := T#60S);
iPreviousState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* IDLE_STANDBY_COLD: Actuators de-energized, waiting for master enable *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tip_V    := 0.0;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Tilt_V   := 0.0;
        rFSM_PiezoVolt_Piston_V := 0.0;
        rLaserLOTuning_Current_mA        := 0.0;
        rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_Az_mrads := 0.0;
        rCoarseGimbalRateDemand_El_mrads := 0.0;
        IF bEnable THEN
            iState := 10; (* Transition to Power-On Self-Test *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* INITIALIZATION_SELF_TEST_POST: Piezo continuity check & memory verification *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        u_mpc_accum_Az          := 65.0; (* Pre-charge piezos to mid-stroke *)
        u_mpc_accum_El          := 65.0;
        IF NOT bAcc_AllFailed_Trip THEN
            iState := 20; (* Transition to Thermal & Optical Frequency Stabilization *)
        ELSE
            dwAlarmWord_Critical := dwAlarmWord_Critical OR 16#0000_0080; (* POST Failure *)
            iState := 999;
        END_IF;

    20: (* THERMAL_STABILIZATION_LASER_LOCK: TEC stabilizes laser seed submount *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        IF ABS(rLaserSeedTemp_degC - c_rLaserSeedNominalTemp_degC) <= 0.25 THEN
            iState := 30; (* Ready for Coarse Pointing Hand-Off *)
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    30: (* COARSE_POINTING_GIMBAL_HANDOFF: Wait for CPA to settle inside acquisition cone *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        IF bCoarseAcquisitionValid THEN
            rSpiralScanAngle_rad   := 0.0;
            rSpiralScanRadius_urad := 0.0;
            iState := 40; (* Initiate Spatial Beacon Search *)
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    40: (* BEAM_NUTATION_SPIRAL_SEARCH: Archimedean spiral trajectory search *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        (* Generate Archimedean spiral search commands *)
        rSpiralScanAngle_rad   := rSpiralScanAngle_rad + (12.5 * c_rTs);
        rSpiralScanRadius_urad := rSpiralScanRadius_urad + (1.2 * c_rTs);
        rTargetAngle_Az_urad   := rSpiralScanRadius_urad * COS(rSpiralScanAngle_rad);
        rTargetAngle_El_urad   := rSpiralScanRadius_urad * SIN(rSpiralScanAngle_rad);
        
        (* Check for optical beacon arrival on Quad-Cell *)
        IF (rQuadSum_mV >= 85.0) OR bBeaconModulationDetected THEN
            rTargetAngle_Az_urad := 0.0;
            rTargetAngle_El_urad := 0.0;
            iState := 50; (* Transition to Centroid Lock Acquisition *)
        END_IF;
        IF rSpiralScanRadius_urad > 80.0 THEN
            (* Spiral search expired without detection *)
            dwAlarmWord_Warning := dwAlarmWord_Warning OR 16#0000_2000; (* Beacon Search Timeout *)
            iState := 30; (* Re-arm coarse hand-off *)
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    50: (* QUAD_CELL_CENTROID_LOCK_ACQUISITION: Spot pull-in into linear field-of-view *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        IF (ABS(rLinearizedPos_Az_urad) <= c_rLinearFOV_urad) AND 
           (ABS(rLinearizedPos_El_urad) <= c_rLinearFOV_urad) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Heterodyne Doppler Lock *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rQuadSum_mV < 30.0) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Drop back to spiral search if lost *)
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    60: (* DOPPLER_SWEEP_FREQUENCY_LOCK: Heterodyne intermediate frequency acquisition *)
        bSystemReady            := FALSE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := FALSE;
        IF bDopplerPhaseLocked THEN
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Closed-Loop MPC Fine Tracking *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rQuadSum_mV < 30.0) THEN iState := 110; END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    70: (* CLOSED_LOOP_MPC_FINE_TRACKING: Sub-microradian jitter minimization active *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := TRUE; (* Open transmit shutter *)
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad <= c_rJitterTarget_urad) AND bDopplerPhaseLocked THEN
            iState := 80; (* Fully locked: Engage High-Rate 10 Gbps Communication *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad > c_rJitterTripThreshold_urad) THEN
            iState := 100; (* Transition to Degraded Jitter Recovery *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rRxOpticalPower_dBm < c_rRxPowerTrip_dBm) THEN iState := 110; END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    80: (* HIGH_RATE_10GBPS_COMM_DATA_TRANSCEIVER: Full payload transmission active *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bCommLinkActive         := TRUE; (* 10 Gbps payload transport enabled *)
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := TRUE;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad > c_rJitterWarning_urad) THEN
            bCommLinkActive := FALSE; (* Temporarily throttle payload data *)
            iState := 90; (* Engage Micro-Vibration Feedforward Jitter Attenuation *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rRxOpticalPower_dBm < c_rRxPowerTrip_dBm) THEN
            bCommLinkActive := FALSE;
            iState := 110; (* Fast Relock Sequence *)
        END_IF;
        IF NOT bEnable THEN iState := 120; END_IF;

    90: (* MICRO_VIBRATION_FEEDFORWARD_ATTENUATION: Enhanced structural anti-jitter nulling *)
        bSystemReady            := TRUE;
        bCommLinkActive         := FALSE;
        bOpticalTxShutterOpen   := TRUE;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad <= c_rJitterTarget_urad) THEN
            iState := 80; (* Return to Full 10 Gbps Communication *)
        END_IF;
        IF (rTrackingError_RMS_urad > c_rJitterTripThreshold_urad) THEN
            iState := 100; (* Severe disturbance: enter degraded mode *)
        END_IF;
